categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Wallet covers descriptor management. The PR adds CreateMultisigDescriptor() in src/script/descriptor.cpp to safely construct and validate multisig descriptors for wallet imports and multisig setup flows.
categories.rationale: Adds structured creation of P2WSH and P2TR multisig descriptors to replace error-prone manual string assembly. While it provides real utility and unblocks multisig tooling (#35645, #36325), it is an uncalled helper function in bitcoind and reasonably deferrable while the broader setup flow is settled.
